pr_title: util: expose diff function used by the assertion errors
pr_body:
fix: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/51740

Exporting the new `util.diff(actual, expected)` function.  

This function is the one internally used by the `assert` module when an `AssertionError` occurs and it is just an utility to better show differences between the two params `actual` and `expected`.  

It is internally using the "new" `Myers` diff algorithm so you can expect the same output provided by this PR: https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/54862

issue_context.title: Expose `createErrDiff` for diffing objects
issue_context.body:
### What is the problem this feature will solve?

I like the general format of the `deepStrictEqual` diff comparisons, but it would be nice to get this functionality "natively" to print a diff instead of forcing it to error to see a diff.

### What is the feature you are proposing to solve the problem?

Expose `createErrDiff` from `assert` https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/544cfc5ef151bca8d625fbccc581200a77b00bc0/lib/internal/assert/assertion_error.js#L79

### What alternatives have you considered?

Userland diff tool, but if the code is already there it would be nice to expose it
comments: The current implementation is not ideal. I would not expose that for now. It is just a best effort implementation and not e.g., Myers .
Just a little update here: #54862 will switch the alg to Myers

review_comments: Can we deactivate the colors by default? I think it's a good idea to add that only if requested.
I guess you are confusing it with the "pretty printed" version of Myers. This implementation only returns the raw data
